newsitem.title: GERMANY: Sweets and champagne, from east Germany with love.
newsitem.headline: Sweets and champagne, from east Germany with love.

text.p: Thousands of western Germans including Chancellor Helmut Kohl will open their mailboxes on Saturday to find a special delivery from their eastern neighbours.

Bundles of Little Red Riding Hood champagne, Hallorenkugeln chocolates and Halberstaedt sausages were shipped westward on Friday in a campaign to introduce western Germans to the cream of the former communist East's consumer-products crop.

The Saxony-Anhalt Agricultural Marketing Society and eastern political leaders are hoping their business partners, acquaintances and even the country's stout leader will become hooked on the eastern delicacies.
"The products are the best and soon a lot of west Germans will know that too," Hasso Mansfield of the Agricultural Marketing Society told the Berliner Morgenpost.

Many Westerners sent packages of their favourite home grown specialities to their eastern brethren in the years before the collapse of the Berlin Wall. But six years after reunification, they remain reluctant consumers of eastern-produced goods.
